label: later-life
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: THREE separate tall portrait game backgrounds arranged as equal-width columns side by side, without gutters, frames or dividing rules. Each portrait is approximately 1:2.16, overall canvas approximately 3:2.16. Create full rectangular paintings, NOT icons. The supplied images are style/continuity references: luminous opaque gouache, selective fine ink, lapis, jade, burnt ochre, muted coral, warm ivory light. Monumental and intimate, a world being created, never a settlement. No text, numbers, words, ornamental borders, people unless explicitly specified, buildings, UI or watermark. Place dramatic landmarks mainly in the UPPER 42 percent of EACH portrait; the LOWER 58 percent must be a spacious calm medium-LIGHT desaturated blue-grey/ochre painted foreground with sparse broad atmospheric strokes, giving dark circular tokens readable working space. This calm area belongs naturally to each painting, not a rectangular UI panel or flat overlay. Preserve the three equal portrait panels. Recurring geography when visible: hooked ochre headland at upper left, a single arched cave at its foot when the requested era permits a cave, teal tidal inlet, pale dry rock shelf on the RIGHT inside the entrance and a broad dry upper interior wall above the tidal wash. The dry shelf is connected to exposed rock at the mouth, visibly above the water; do not flood the whole floor. Distant jagged coastal hills, pale Moon with a pair of adjacent unequal craters, consistent with reference. No actual Earth map. LEFT: Same hooked cave coastline with recovered young broadleaf woodland and a few tiny shrew-like mammals, distant mountain glacier high on the skyline. The old glacier is confined to the HIGH PEAKS; no advancing valley ice sheet yet. Cooler daylight, not another impact winter. NO giant browsers or humans. The dry cave shelf remains above the sea. Quiet pale shore below. CENTER: Same coastal world after the ice retreats: warm green broadleaf woodland, flowing river, exposed pale moraine gravel high in the background and only a small remnant glacier on far peaks. A tiny primate-like tree dweller rests on a branch, no people, no living giant browsers. Life is diverse and the landscape carries a trace of past ice. Quiet lower shore. RIGHT: The SAME coast under a luminous paired-crater full Moon. Three small warm dark-earth human silhouettes seen mainly from behind stand on the dry upper shore looking up at the sky, one pointing. They have not yet painted or built anything; no houses, books, instruments, carved monuments or written marks. Large night sky, star pattern not joined by lines. Lower working space is pale moonlit sea/sand, not black. Dry cave at upper left remains recognizable.
